boundary_definition: absolute F-ST home-win probability distance from 0.5 below 0.05
interpretation: Every frozen-FST winner-pick disagreement with market occurred inside the approximately 45%-55% F-ST decision zone. All five of F-ST's net additional correct winners came from this boundary region. Away from the decision boundary, F-ST and market selected the same winner and therefore had identical straight-up accuracy.
research_implication: Under an accuracy-first objective, late-horizon/player/news research has highest potential value when it changes the winner decision near the incumbent boundary or creates a genuinely large new information shock. Probability refinements that do not change the pick cannot improve straight-up hit rate.
